prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original Cloud Payment Group logo SYMBOL for an Australian payment management and debt recovery service, based on the single attached Pinterest reference's visual design language. The reference is style guidance, not artwork to reproduce. Symbol only: absolutely no letters, text, names, numbers, captions, watermark or presentation labels. A polished graphic designer's flat vector-style mark with precise edges and deliberate negative space. Cobalt/deep blue is primary, warm burnt orange only when structurally meaningful, on plain warm ivory. Center one large emblem with generous whitespace, square canvas. No faces, eyes, mouths, characters, mascots, hands, cups, coffee beans, money signs, shields, tangled ribbons, 3D, shading, gradients, texture, mockups or extra props. The metaphor should be visible through simple construction, never through added decorative icons. DIRECTION 1 — sculptural cafe identity. Study the reference's thick high-contrast sculpted strokes, generous bowls, deeply cut flowing counters and beautifully controlled concave curves. Translate that grammar into a compact cloud-like silhouette, NOT lettering. Build a SINGLE solid deep-blue cloud symbol with one broad elegant ivory channel passing through its lower half and exiting cleanly right, suggesting a cleared route through a blockage. One small orange shape at the exit must complete the cloud contour, like the last piece finding its place. Metaphor: clearing a path to payment resolution. Three broad cloud lobes maximum, thick confident silhouette, minimal cuts, sculptural cafe-stamp elegance. It should feel like a bespoke cafe emblem executed by an excellent identity designer, not a cloud storage app.
